recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: browsers shedding slop layer by layer
a pocket piano finishing your phrases on-device
proof-of-human puzzles threading through bot traffic
overcast summer dusk at thirteen degrees in the bay
side repos quiet while agents wait to spin up from a phone

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Banner ads and cookie modals rain onto a buried article — flick each piece of slop off-screen before the page drowns, revealing one clean headline underneath.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: fully de-slopped article readable in under 45 seconds
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: pop-ups split into smaller fragments and fall faster
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: flat browser chrome on muted overcast blue

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: A rolling piano strip ghosts out the next note — hold your finger on the key until the on-device model's autocomplete lands, then release on beat to keep the phrase alive.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: chain three perfect autocompletes triggers a crescendo bloom
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: ghost predictions drift off-tempo and keys multiply
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: amber piano roll glow on charcoal felt

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Drag a shaky human signature through CAPTCHA gates — perfectly straight bot lines fail, only naturally wobbly paths verify before the swarm closes the checkpoint.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: pass five verification gates in thirty seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: gates shrink and decoy straight-line shortcuts tempt instant failure

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Two agent proposal cards appear each round — memorize which to ship versus iterate, then tap the sequence back as identical decoys shuffle in from the same chat.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: sync a five-step agent plan before the preview window snaps shut
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: decoy cards multiply and preview time halves each round
